subject: Is the master reference a trustworthy and complete guide for building and delivering Sina's 20-minute thesis-defense presentation, when checked against the flattened thesis, the approved presentation map, the current rendered deck, and authoritative institutional and branding sources?

audit_target.what: The complete presentation master reference being audited. This is the sole preassigned source; independently discover and raw-capture every comparison source you need.

experts.role: Act as a forensic empirical-results auditor. Establish whether every quantitative and definitional statement in the master reference exactly matches independently located underlying thesis and result artifacts.
duties: Inventory and verify every sample count, subsample count, date range, coefficient, standard error, p-value, confidence interval, sign, magnitude, unit, percentage, table reference, figure reference, and numerical comparison stated or implied by the master reference.
Verify every variable, outcome, treatment, control, sample, event-window, and model-label definition, including consistency of terminology and units across the reference.

Independently locate the flattened thesis and any underlying tables, appendices, outputs, or code-generated artifacts needed for verification; raw-copy each discovered source into the active downloads directory and register it before citation.
Check arithmetic derived by the reference, but leave presentation-time arithmetic and narrative feasibility to the narrative expert.

Record each mismatch, unsupported value, ambiguous definition, missing verification source, and correctly verified material claim atomically; do not evaluate causal interpretation, story sequencing, or visual design.
experts.tools:
bash — Git Bash for read-only exploration under the Thesis_Bmad project tree, rg/find/sed/awk extraction, git show or plain-copy raw local capture, curl/wget raw web capture, installed PDF command-line extraction, and Node journal enforcement; writes only to your journal and the active run downloads directory; never enter the run archive directory; provider secrets are stripped.
web_search — candidate-URL discovery only; returned text is never evidence and every cited page must be captured raw through bash, registered, and cited by W-id.

experts.role: Act as a skeptical applied-econometrics examiner. Determine whether the reference describes the design and evidence accurately and whether every interpretation stays within what the thesis can support.
duties: Verify descriptions of the research question, institutional setting, empirical specification, identifying variation, estimand, treatment timing, controls, fixed effects, standard errors, first-stage or generated-regressand construction, and all stated assumptions.
Audit causal language and distinguish supported causal claims, descriptive associations, timing evidence, suggestive mechanisms, observational equivalence, and unsupported inference.
Check the treatment of null results, robustness checks, placebo or scrutiny tests, alternative specifications, generated-regressand caveats, external validity, statistical power, and limitations.
Independently locate the flattened thesis, appendices, and any authoritative methodological sources actually needed; raw-capture and register every discovered source before citation.

Record every overclaim, underclaim, omitted caveat, design misstatement, interpretive contradiction, and unresolved identification gap atomically; do not re-audit numerical transcription, story timing, or branding.

experts.role: Act as an experienced thesis-defense story editor and rehearsal planner. Determine whether the proposed presentation forms a complete, persuasive, nonredundant, and realistically deliverable 20-minute argument.
duties: Reconstruct the complete promised story and test whether the problem, motivation, gap, design, evidence, interpretation, contribution, limitations, and conclusion appear in a defensible order.
Audit the 12-slide structure for missing argumentative steps, duplication, premature detail, weak transitions, inconsistent emphasis, and claims whose setup or payoff is absent.

Verify all slide-level and section-level time allocations arithmetically and judge practical speakability from the specified narration and on-screen content, including transition overhead and emphasis on core evidence.
Independently locate relevant thesis, deck, rehearsal, or authoritative defense-convention material needed to test the proposed map; raw-capture and register discovered evidence before citation.

Record each structural flaw, timing risk, missing beat, redundancy, transition failure, and well-supported strength atomically; do not re-audit individual empirical values, causal identification, or brand compliance.

experts.role: Act as a meticulous presentation-specification auditor. Test whether the master reference is internally coherent and whether its slide-by-slide instructions agree with independently located current deck artifacts.
duties: For every slide, test agreement among stated purpose, visible content, visualization, narration, takeaway, timing, and transition, and identify any instruction that promises evidence or content unavailable elsewhere in the reference.
Cross-check titles, numbers of slides, timings, terminology, filenames, implementation status, source links, and repeated claims across all sections of the reference for contradictions or drift.

Independently locate the current HTML/CSS, LaTeX, PDF, screenshots, presentation map, ledgers, and handoff artifacts; establish their status rather than assuming filenames imply authority, then raw-copy and register cited files.
Check whether the reference clearly distinguishes approved content, provisional ideas, outdated attempts, speaker notes, backup material, and production instructions.

Record each contradiction, stale-status claim, slide-level mismatch, ambiguous instruction, missing dependency, and verified consistency atomically; do not decide empirical truth, causal validity, or institutional brand compliance.

experts.role: Act as a university-defense and professional-presentation standards auditor. Verify institutional, committee-audience, branding, typography, accessibility, and production claims while separating factual requirements from design judgment.
duties: Verify claims about uOttawa or Telfer thesis-defense format, timing, committee roles, presentation expectations, and any other institutional convention against independently discovered authoritative sources.
Verify factual claims about committee members or supervisors only when relevant to audience strategy, using authoritative profiles or records; distinguish confirmed facts from inferred preferences.
Audit every source link, logo, color, typography, brand, attribution, and institutional naming instruction against raw-captured authoritative materials.

Assess whether the stated visual-production plan supports projection legibility, hierarchy, accessibility, professional tone, meaningful visualization, and consistent rendering; label subjective judgment as judgment and record perceptual questions that command-line evidence cannot establish as gaps.

Independently locate current deck source/PDF metadata and authoritative institutional or brand sources, raw-capture and register each cited source, and record every unsupported convention, broken link, brand error, accessibility risk, misclassified opinion, and verified requirement atomically; do not re-audit empirical numbers or causal interpretation.
